pages.title: Autoclave
pages.text: A thick steel drum that fills with steam under pressure, hotter than boiling, until nothing alive is left inside.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the hold time and the steam temperature. Each D minutes at temperature kill nine in ten of what is there, and D falls tenfold for every 10 K hotter; the hold must reach the recipe's number of tenfold reductions (12 for a Sterile Pack). Shorter holds are faster. Above 410 K the packs scorch.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Sterile Pack.
